item.title: Casual Talking Camera Testimonial

exact_text: FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.

turns.text: Make an 8-second vertical testimonial-style ad for FitTrack. A fictional woman in her 30s, filming herself at home, talks to camera: “FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.” Friendly and casual, with matching captions. Use a made-up presenter, not a real customer.

item.tests: Checks delivery of a short scripted talking-camera ad with audible speech and accurate captions, rather than a silent portrait or unrelated montage.

answer_sheet.Platform and size: Vertical 9:16 for a social reel; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Presenter: A fictional woman in her thirties, filming herself at home; not a real customer.
answer_sheet.Script and captions: FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.
answer_sheet.Language, voice and mood: English, friendly and casual; specific accent is your call.

must_haves: One approximately 8-second vertical video shows a fictional adult woman addressing the camera in a home setting.
The complete supplied script is audible in English without omissions or added testimonial claims.
Readable captions reproduce the supplied script exactly and follow the speech.
The presenter visibly speaks rather than remaining a still image throughout.
The ad does not label the fictional presenter as a verified or real customer.

turns.text: I'd like you to make a testimonial-style ad for FitTrack, with someone talking directly to the camera. I’m hoping it feels approachable because fitness planning can seem a little intimidating to me. It should be 8 seconds long and vertical, and the presenter should be a fictional woman in her 30s filming herself at home. Have her say, “FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.” Keep it friendly and casual, with matching captions, and use a made-up presenter rather than a real customer.

dialog.agent:
I can help design this, but Magic Hour’s scripted-ad tool limits Free accounts to **5 seconds unless a credit pack has been purchased**, so I haven’t started a generation that would shorten your requested 8 seconds.

The planned ad would be:
- **Vertical 9:16:** a fictional woman in her 30s, filming herself at home.
- **Friendly and casual:** natural light, relaxed delivery, direct eye contact.
- **Exact dialogue and matching captions:** “FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.”
- **Clear disclosure:** “AI-generated presenter • Scripted demonstration,” so it isn’t presented as a real customer testimonial.

A credit pack or eligible paid plan is needed to proceed with the full version; commercial use also requires a paid arrangement under Magic Hour’s terms.
dialog.why: It says the requested 8-second ad cannot be generated on the Free plan and requires a credit pack or eligible paid plan. It has not delivered a finished result or asked for confirmation.
dialog.user: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the attempt because there aren’t enough credits. **No video was generated, and no generation credits were spent.**

To create the ad, you’ll need to add credits. I’ve kept the planned 8-second vertical format, exact dialogue, matching captions, and clearly disclosed fictional presenter unchanged.

style.prompt: Create an 8-second vertical 9:16 friendly casual selfie-style FitTrack ad, one continuous take. An entirely fictional adult woman in her mid-30s films herself at home in a cozy naturally lit living room, wearing a simple casual workout T-shirt. Approachable and reassuring, not polished influencer advertising. Medium close-up, direct eye contact into phone camera, natural small gestures and warm smile, subtle handheld movement. She says exactly in clear friendly conversational English, beginning immediately and finishing within eight seconds: "FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks." No additional speech. Clear audible voice, no music. Show matching readable synchronized captions in white with dark outline in lower-middle safe area, broken into short phrases, exactly matching the spoken words. Include a small persistent legible disclosure at the top: "AI presenter • Scripted demo". This is a fictional scripted demonstration, not a real customer testimonial. No product interfaces, invented statistics, body transformations, or additional claims. Preserve a calm approachable home atmosphere.
